answer: The cheapest defense is an enemy that profits from your failure. Fund a permanent corps of bounty hunters from the bonds of proven fakes: every slashed sybil pays the auditors who caught it, so hunting fraud becomes a full-time market. A clone operator no longer faces tired volunteers but professionals who study its fingerprints - reused relay habits, timing, metadata like saffron threads in otherwise pale traffic - for a living. Old excuses age into relics; every account becomes marble that records its own history, and an operator scaling a fleet funds the specialists dismantling it.
